entries.title: Monday run by the river
entries.content: Ran 8 km along the river before work. Legs felt heavy but I kept a steady pace and finished in 46 minutes.

entries.title: Sourdough attempt
entries.content: My first sourdough loaf came out dense. The starter was only three days old, so I will wait a week before trying again.

entries.title: Dentist appointment
entries.content: Dr. Okafor found one small cavity and booked a filling for the 14th. The cleaning itself was painless.

entries.title: Train to Edinburgh
entries.content: Took the 07:15 train to Edinburgh. Spent the ride reading a novel about lighthouse keepers and watching sheep out of the window.

entries.title: Budget review
entries.content: Went through the bank statements. Subscriptions cost me 62 pounds a month, and I cancelled the two streaming services I never use.

entries.title: Mum's birthday
entries.content: Called Mum for her 60th birthday. We agreed to cook her favourite lamb stew together when I visit in March.

entries.title: Bike repair
entries.content: The rear tyre had a slow puncture. Replaced the inner tube in the garage and oiled the chain while I was at it.

entries.title: Spanish lesson
entries.content: Learned the past tense of regular verbs in Spanish. Still mixing up fui and fue, need more practice with flashcards.

entries.title: Garden tomatoes
entries.content: The first tomatoes finally ripened on the balcony. Picked six cherry tomatoes and ate them warm from the plant.

entries.title: Job interview prep
entries.content: Practised answers for Thursday's interview at the logistics startup. The hardest question will be about a time I disagreed with a manager.

entries.title: Rainy cinema night
entries.content: Watched an old black and white film about a jazz pianist at the small cinema on Elm Street. The soundtrack was wonderful.

entries.title: New laptop
entries.content: Ordered a refurbished laptop with 32 GB of memory. It should arrive next Tuesday and will replace the one with the broken hinge.

entries.title: Hiking Ben Nevis
entries.content: Climbed Ben Nevis with Priya. Clouds covered the summit, but we reached the top in about five hours and ate sandwiches in the wind.

entries.title: Book club
entries.content: Book club met at Sam's flat. We argued about the ending of the novel for two hours and agreed to read a biography of a polar explorer next.

entries.title: Insomnia night
entries.content: Could not sleep until 3 am. I read for a while, drank chamomile tea and decided to stop looking at my phone after ten.

entries.title: Moving boxes
entries.content: Packed the kitchen into twelve boxes. Found my grandmother's recipe tin at the back of a cupboard and put it in my bag so it cannot get lost.

entries.title: Coffee with Jonas
entries.content: Met Jonas at the cafe near the station. He is moving to Lisbon in June to work as a ceramic designer.

entries.title: Piano practice
entries.content: Spent forty minutes on the slow movement of a Beethoven sonata. The left hand is still uneven in bar 17.

entries.title: Volunteering shift
entries.content: Worked a shift at the food bank sorting tinned goods. We packed 140 parcels, and the manager thanked everyone with homemade flapjacks.

entries.title: Tax return
entries.content: Submitted my self-assessment tax return a week before the deadline. I owe 480 pounds and set up a payment for the end of the month.

entries.title: Swimming lesson
entries.content: Third swimming lesson. I can now do front crawl for two lengths without stopping, and the coach fixed my breathing rhythm.

entries.title: Dream about a house
entries.content: Dreamt that my old school had turned into a house with a hundred staircases. I kept trying to find the kitchen and woke up hungry.

entries.title: Car service
entries.content: Took the car for its annual service. The garage replaced the brake pads and the bill came to 215 pounds.

entries.title: Photography walk
entries.content: Walked through the old docks with my camera at sunrise. The best shot was a rusted crane reflected in a puddle.

entries.title: Team retrospective
entries.content: At work we held a retrospective on the last release. The main lesson was to write the deployment checklist before the code freeze.

entries.title: Pottery class
entries.content: Made my first bowl on the wheel. It collapsed twice, but the third one survived and the teacher said it would be glazed in dark green.

entries.title: Thunderstorm
entries.content: A thunderstorm knocked out the power for three hours. We played cards by candlelight and the neighbours brought over soup.

entries.title: Learning to cook curry
entries.content: Cooked a chickpea curry from scratch with coconut milk and fresh ginger. Too much chilli, but everyone finished their plate.

entries.title: Library visit
entries.content: Borrowed four books at the library, including one on the history of cartography. The librarian recommended a quiet reading corner upstairs.

entries.title: Football with the cousins
entries.content: Played five-a-side football with my cousins. We lost 7-5, and I scored twice with my weaker left foot.

entries.title: Vet visit
entries.content: Took Biscuit the cat to the vet for her vaccinations. She weighs 4.2 kilos and has to lose a little weight, so no more treats.

entries.title: Concert tickets
entries.content: Bought tickets for the folk concert at the town hall on 21 November. Priya and Sam are coming, and seats are in row F.

entries.title: Grandfather's stories
entries.content: Dad told stories about Grandfather working as a ship's radio operator in the 1960s. He once sent a message to a boat near Iceland.

entries.title: Meditation week
entries.content: Finished the seventh day of morning meditation. Ten minutes of breathing practice makes my commute feel much calmer.

entries.title: Apartment viewing
entries.content: Viewed a flat on Harbour Road with a small balcony and south-facing windows. Rent is 1150 pounds, which is above my budget.

entries.title: Learning chess
entries.content: Played online chess for an hour and lost four games in a row. I keep giving away my queen by moving too fast.
